author: GamingBolt
description:
Released less than two years after Onimusha: Warlords' success, Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny represents a slightly different shift in storytelling and gameplay. In terms of presentation, it leaned more into realism, and before Way of the Sword ever revealed the late Toshiro Mifune's likeness for its protagonist, we had Yūsaku Matsuda playing Jubei in Onimusha 2. The same Matsuda who would inspire characters like Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star.

With all that in mind, Jubei's journey begins on a far more tragic note, with Nobunaga destroying the Yagyu village. The opening montage sees the latter's army mercilessly slaughtering the villagers, and though they make some effort to fight back, they're no match for the Genma.
title: Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny - The COMPLETE STORY - Before You Play Onimusha Way of the Sword

author: GamingBolt
description:
Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 is out on August 25th for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC, and the excitement is palpable, especially after I had a chance to go hands-on with the Prologue mission and first campaign (consisting of three missions) on PC.

Obviously, this isn't the final build, but the atmosphere and tension of the classic films were unmistakably out in full force and drew me into the trials of the UAS Endeavor's Colonial Marines. It also offered a chance to try out the new systems and gameplay features, including the new Classes, ahead of launch.
title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 - 15 MORE Things You Need To Know Before You Pre-Order

author: GamingBolt
description:
With Star Wars’s cinematic universe marrying so well with turn-based tactics, it’s surprising that the galaxy far, far away hasn’t ventured this meaningfully into the genre before. But, it’s here now: Star Wars Zero Company puts you in command of a ragtag team of operatives, with studio Bit Reactor - a team composed of former XCOM developers - bringing tactical, cover-based combat, character-driven storytelling, and the franchise’s signature blockbuster presentation to the tactics experience. 

It’s definitely more than XCOM meets the Clone Wars, though, so here are fifteen things you need to know before you buy Star Wars Zero Company.
title: Star Wars Zero Company - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
